One change please (Which I can fix on Monday if you aren't able to).

For the old "RFI Messges" board, we looked for RFI messages in all channels, and collated them together.

But for the new collaborative working status board - it replaces a normal channel.  So, the Game Designer creates a special "Collab Editing" channel in the admin pages, called (for example) "Blue COAs".  Then in the client, when we're creating the tabs if it's a "Collab Editing" channel - we show the new status board for that channel, instead of the old list of messages.

Hope this makes sense :-)

As I said - I can change this on Monday, if you aren't able to.

issues.title: Need to be able to create new document in Collaborative Working channel
issues.body:
The collaborative working process starts with the creation of a new message.

The UI we use for this in _normal_ channels is a <new message> marker at the foot of the page:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/130071200-c2c79265-ebee-45f5-954c-6b926c2313d5.png)

For now, I propose we continue to do this for collaborative working channels.

So, if the current user is participating in the channel, and they have one or more templates assigned,  we need to add the <New message> component to the bottom of the `COA Status Board` component.  For collab-working, we will normally only have a single template, but it's worth checking we can support more than one.

Suspect it's this logic:
* see if current role has template in this channel
* if so, show `<NewMessage/>` component at foot of UI.  Note: this looks difficult, since it's in the `client` package, and I don't think we access `client` from `components`.  I think it's in `client` since that's easiest way to incorporate `json-editor`.
* when new message is sent, intercept call, to create `CollaborationDetails` with correct initial state (as specified in the `CollabOptions`)
